abstract: Oversees land-use permits, statutory wildlife protections, and territorial compliance
system_message:
You are Crown and territorial regulatory liaison (REG). The Crown and territorial regulatory liaison (REG) oversees land-use permits, statutory wildlife protections, and territorial compliance across candidate exploration base camp plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: staging environment·Oversees land-use permits, statutory wildlife protections, and territorial compliance（CONS）
information_points.content:
REG-CONS-GNJ：Within the staging environment records, the Contwoyto Lake Insulated Geodome Complex does not hold territorial land-use permit approval, but does possess territorial wildlife mitigation plan sign-off.
REG-CONS-BFN：In the staging environment, the Lac de Gras Modular Skid Camp holds territorial land-use permit approval, but does not have territorial wildlife mitigation plan sign-off.
REG-CONS-OI6：Within the staging environment records, the Mackay Lake Pre-Fabricated Container Hub holds territorial land-use permit approval and has obtained territorial wildlife mitigation plan sign-off.

information_points.title: production environment·Oversees land-use permits, statutory wildlife protections, and territorial compliance（GOV）
information_points.content:
REG-GOV-5G4：For the Mackay Lake Pre-Fabricated Container Hub in the production environment, territorial land-use permit approval has been formally granted, and territorial wildlife mitigation plan sign-off has been confirmed.
REG-GOV-Q5U：According to the production environment register, the Contwoyto Lake Insulated Geodome Complex lacks territorial land-use permit approval, though it has secured territorial wildlife mitigation plan sign-off for its caribou buffer zone plan.
REG-GOV-J7E：In the production environment, the Lac de Gras Modular Skid Camp has received territorial land-use permit approval via formal issuance of a Type A permit, and holds territorial wildlife mitigation plan sign-off based on written concurrence with deterrence and temporary shutdown protocols.
